name: CK+ Extended (Kaggle repackaging)

benchmark_protocol.purpose: Supplementary seven-class reproducibility check; not a substitute for in-the-wild retail data.

provenance_note: The CSV is a third-party Kaggle repackaging. The project does not claim that its split is an official CK+ protocol. The original Extended Cohn-Kanade dataset is described by Lucey et al. (2010).
